group-zj-2026-jan-seven-choices.overview: 本文讨论阅读中的“回读”(regression)现象：区分因走神而回读（浪费时间）与因真正没读懂而回读（合理的修复策略），并给出保持专注、克服回读坏习惯的方法。

discourseStructure.summary: 文章先提出回读现象并指出其常见原因是注意力不集中(走神/打盹)，随后分别给出保持专注的方法和打破回读坏习惯的步骤，最后辩证地指出回读本身在监控理解时是合理的，但因走神而回读才是浪费时间。

units.summary: 提出回读现象，指出其原因往往不是看不懂而是没在认真读(走神/打盹)，并把这种回读定义为 regression。
走神是缺乏投入造成的习惯，应严格要求自己全神贯注，让大脑真正参与文本。
回读是为弥补浪费时间的拐杖；要先意识到何时为何回读，再剥夺自己回读的权利以打破习惯。
辩证总结：因没读懂而回读是合理的修复策略并被好读者使用，但因走神而回读则是浪费时间。

topicClues: too difficult to comprehend on the first reading

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Is it because the material is too difficult to comprehend on the first reading or because you are asleep?
contextEvidence.afterQuote: You are napping (打盹) or daydreaming.

mechanismSignals.relation: the latter 指代空前选择疑问句中后一个原因 because you are asleep，与空后 napping/daydreaming 呼应。
空前 “too difficult... or because you are asleep” 二选一，the latter 正指其中后者。
空后用 napping/daydreaming 进一步坐实 the latter(asleep) 为真。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前是选择疑问句“是因太难还是因犯困”，B 用 the latter 指代后者(asleep)，并被空后 You are napping 印证，承上启下。

matchedClues.relation: the latter 精确指代选择疑问句的后一项 asleep。

matchedClues.contextSide: You are napping (打盹) or daydreaming
matchedClues.relation: 空后对“犯困”的展开证实了 B 的判断。

keyDistractors.reason: A “Both are to blame” 会把两个原因都算上，但空后只展开了 napping/daydreaming 一项，并未支持“太难”，故不成立。

q-zj-2026-jan-036.teachingNote: 遇到选择疑问句作空前时，留意 the former/the latter 等指代词与后文展开方向的对应，确定到底指哪一项。

topicClues: no idea what you have read
not because you did not understand

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Halfway down the page you realize that you have no idea what you have read.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Thus, you go back and reread, not because you did not understand, but because you were not paying attention.

mechanismSignals.relation: E 中 “mind was not(engaged)” 与空后 not paying attention 同义，解释为何读完毫无印象。

mechanismSignals.signalText: no idea what you have read
mechanismSignals.targetText: Your eyes were engaged, but your mind was not
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前“毫无印象”正因眼到而心未到，E 给出原因。
空后 “not because you did not understand, but because you were not paying attention” 与 E 的“眼到心未到”一致。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前说读完“毫无印象”，E 用“眼睛在读但大脑没投入”给出原因，并与空后“不是没读懂而是没专注”精确呼应。

matchedClues.contextSide: no idea what you have read
matchedClues.optionSide: Your eyes were engaged, but your mind was not
matchedClues.relation: 眼到心未到导致毫无印象。

matchedClues.contextSide: because you were not paying attention
matchedClues.relation: mind was not engaged 即 not paying attention。

keyDistractors.reason: G 强调“因没读懂而回读是合理策略”，但空后明确说 not because you did not understand，方向相反，故排除。

q-zj-2026-jan-037.teachingNote: 抓住空后 “not... but...” 的对比，反向锁定空处应解释“没专注/心未到”这一原因。

topicClues: your mind is truly occupied with the text

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Visualize the incoming ideas, and relate the new material to what you already know.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: If your mind is truly occupied with the text, you will not be able to think about Friday night

mechanismSignals.relation: C 中 think the ideas 与空前 Visualize the incoming ideas、Engage your mind 同属“让大脑参与思考”话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Don’t just read the words; think the ideas
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前 Engage your mind 与 C 的“别只读字面、要思考内容”一致。

mechanismSignals.signalText: mind is truly occupied with the text
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“大脑被文本占据”延续 C 的“思考内容”而非只读字词。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段都在讲“让大脑投入”，C “别只读字面，要思考内容” 与上文 Engage your mind、Visualize ideas 及下文 mind occupied 构成同一祈使句式的方法链。

matchedClues.contextSide: Engage your mind / Visualize the incoming ideas
matchedClues.optionSide: Don’t just read the words; think the ideas
matchedClues.relation: 都强调主动思考而非被动看字。

matchedClues.contextSide: your mind is truly occupied with the text
matchedClues.relation: 思考内容才能使大脑真正被文本占据。

keyDistractors.reason: D “大声朗读几分钟” 虽与阅读相关，但本段主旨是“让大脑思考投入”，且与前后祈使句的“思考”链条不衔接，故排除。

q-zj-2026-jan-038.teachingNote: 段内多句祈使句并列时，所填句应在形式与话题上延续这一方法链，选与上下文同义同向的祈使建议。

topicClues: become aware of when and why you are regressing

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: First of all, become aware of when and why you are regressing.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Say, “OK. I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going

mechanismSignals.relation: F 以 Then 承接空前 First of all，构成“第一步…接着第二步”的步骤顺序。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Then, start denying yourself the right
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前 First of all 是第一步，需要 Then 引出的第二步与之衔接。
空后“继续往下读、不回读”正是 F 中“剥夺自己回读权利以打破习惯”的具体做法。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前 First of all 是克服回读的第一步，F 用 Then 引出第二步“剥夺自己回读的权利以打破习惯”，并被空后“继续往下读不回头”所例证。

matchedClues.optionSide: Then, start denying yourself the right
matchedClues.relation: First of all 与 Then 构成步骤先后关系。

matchedClues.contextSide: I’m going to keep on going
matchedClues.optionSide: in order to break the habit
matchedClues.relation: 继续往下读、不回读即打破回读坏习惯的执行。

keyDistractors.reason: C 也是祈使建议，但本段话题是“打破回读习惯”的步骤，且缺少 Then 这类承接 First of all 的顺序信号，故 F 更优。

q-zj-2026-jan-039.teachingNote: 看到空前出现 First of all 等序数/起始信号，优先选含 Then/Next 等承接词、延续步骤链的选项。

topicClues: Good readers who monitor their own comprehension
use it in the reading process
regressing because your mind was asleep is a waste of time

contextEvidence.afterQuote: Good readers who monitor their own comprehension use it in the reading process. However, regressing because your mind was asleep is a waste of time.

mechanismSignals.targetText: use it in the reading process
mechanismSignals.relation: G 主语 Rereading 即空后代词 it 的指代对象，作为段首主题句被下文 use it 接续。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Rereading because you did not understand
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 it 指代 G 中提出的 Rereading(合理的修复策略)，故段首须出现该名词。

mechanismSignals.targetText: regressing because your mind was asleep is a waste of time
mechanismSignals.relation: However 把 G 的“因没读懂而回读是合理的”与“因走神而回读是浪费时间”对比，故段首应是正面评价回读的句子。

optionFit.fitSummary: 段首总起句：G 指出“因没读懂而回读是合理的修复策略”，被空后 use it 指代、并由 However 与“因走神回读是浪费时间”形成对比，统领全段。

matchedClues.contextSide: Good readers... use it in the reading process
matchedClues.optionSide: Rereading because you did not understand is a reasonable fix-up strategy
matchedClues.relation: 好读者使用 it(回读)印证其为合理策略。

matchedClues.contextSide: However, regressing because your mind was asleep is a waste of time
matchedClues.relation: However 形成“合理 vs 浪费”的对比，需正面句作前项。

keyDistractors.reason: E 描述“眼到心未到”，无法作为被 it 指代、并与 However 对比的正面主题句，且话题与本段“回读是否合理”不符。

q-zj-2026-jan-040.teachingNote: 段首空处常为主题句，结合空后代词 it 的指代对象与 However 引出的对比项，反推应填的正面总起句。
